title: Tool selection: a narrowed review and a dropped tool that is restored
description: Mechanics of per-task tool selection. The 'review' subtask changes no file, so the local policy leaves out the edit tools. The 'split' subtask is scripted to need Write for a new module, while its text gives no reason for Write: the local policy drops it, the step reports the miss and the tool is restored from the agent's own list. With selection off no step checks its tool. The script decides which tool a step needs; no tool is called.
